description: This file defines an abstract class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_Email' for email attribute validation within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes a method 'unpack' intended to parse email mailbox strings into display-name and address components, though it is not yet implemented.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_Email
classes.description: An abstract class for email URI attribute validation, providing a structure for unpacking email addresses.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Method intended to unpack an email mailbox string into display-name and address components. Currently not implemented.
